description: Mint a play session. Scope is "collection" or "track", and exactly one of collection_id / track_id must be provided (unless the API key is already scoped to that resource). The variants body field is required: a non-empty list of output indexes from adn_list_output_presets (e.g. hq, lq). Returns play_session_id, tracks, and first_track with signed output URLs under the historical variants key — this is how a native/mobile client (or server) obtains signed delivery URLs (first_track.variants[].url); a Client-Side Player key on the device can call it directly (see the native-playback guide). Pass the play_session_id to the ADN Player; use the signed URLs only with a custom player. Playlist scope is not supported. Requires AudioDN OAuth sign-in (call adn_sign_in or complete account login first).
name: adn_create_play_session
